# BCGov Crow - v0.12.0

## Release type

Minor release

## Summary

Crow separates routine framework and dependency maintenance from security
remediation with a dedicated update agent and focused skills included in the
Starter Package and full Crow package.

## Highlights

- The Crow Framework & Dependency Update Agent supports framework/runtime,
  third-party dependency, and combined update scopes without requiring
  security-review reports or ticket workflows.
- Scheduled or unattended runs are limited to supported, non-breaking
  patch/minor updates, defer components without baseline verification, and
  restore a failed component after verification; migrations needing human
  decisions are reported and deferred. Crow does not configure a scheduler.
- Security Remediation retains its existing framework and dependency scopes
  as deprecated compatibility routes through the new skills, while verified
  security findings remain in the security-remediation workflow.
- Security-ticket scopes run applicable vulnerability remediation, hardening,
  and test work only for findings in the validated ticket backlog.
- The dependency-update skill routes inventories through a technology-grouped
  package-manager catalog and supports ecosystems without lockfiles when the
  selected manager and repository policy do not require one.
- Pull-request asset validation checks local links, skill-routing dependencies,
  and whether each collection bundles the transitive skills and modules used by
  its agents.

## Changes

- Added `crow-framework-updates` and `crow-dependency-updates` skills with
  evidence, compatibility, manager-specific lockfile, advisory-check, and
  verification guidance.
- Added a package-manager inventory and routing module covering application
  ecosystems, infrastructure, containers, and non-standard inputs.
- Included the agent and skills in the Starter Package, and updated the
  Security Remediation collection for the deprecated compatibility routes.
- Added a dependency-graph check and regression tests to the Crow asset
  validator; both collections now include the project-context
  technology-preferences module they conditionally use.
- Updated ticket-scope gates, known-skill routing, module-only dependency
  handling, and repository-root link validation.
- Updated package discovery metadata, collection manifests, installation
  examples, and links for Crow v0.12.0.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.12.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.12.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
